posts.subject: Big Pause
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello my fellow admins.


I have an official announcement here.


As you might know, I havent been much active last 2 months. I was dealing with reports and was playing few hours weekly but it wasnt as I imagined. This was because my personal family and school problems which in the end grown to this:I decided to take a month break from PC which means that I wont be able to do admin job at all. So that is the reason why I was deciding between leaving or taking a break. I decided to take a break for one month and after that month I will either do admin again or I will leave admin team depending on my situation in that time.


Thank you for understanding and I wish you good luck with everything.


See ya 3. June 2017 😄


Thorin [;(] [;(] [;(]

hello dear @Thorin Pikachu
well first of all your decision is completely understandable and i'm very sad about the fact that you are in this situation .
i hope you will be back in one month and be with us , I wish you my best of luck on your future and your school problems , take it easy man .
best regards !
Mason
